$comment: Opt-in variant: merge into the repo's .mcp.json when the repo's tasks genuinely need Jira/Confluence access. uvx-launched (no docker-in-docker). Remember: (1) add your Atlassian domain to EXTRA_ALLOWED_DOMAINS in devcontainer.json, (2) credentials come from ~/.agent/agent.env — a scoped service identity, never a personal token, (3) READ_ONLY_MODE is a per-repo decision: keep true for context kits, set false for kits whose job includes updating tickets — the service account's project allowlist is the real boundary.
